statement: A branch cut before a release and merged after it can put its Unreleased changelog entry into the section that release created. Git merges the entry by its surrounding lines, and those lines now sit under the released heading. Incident: #654, a plain-language first page carried forward from #635, which predates 0.6.9, merged on 2026-11-04 with its 48-line Added entry under [0.6.9] — 2026-11-02, though 0.6.9 shipped without it. Neither its review nor its CI noticed. It surfaced only while preparing 0.6.10, when [0.6.9] was diffed against the v0.6.9 tag. Fix: #667 moves the entry to [0.6.10] and restores [0.6.9] to the tag's bytes. Rule: after merging main into a branch, or a branch into main, check that every released section still equals its tag's copy.
